popup.title: Features
popup.askTeacher: Ask your teacher for access to new features

descriptions.Server: Displays a log of all messages sent between micro:bits
descriptions.Translator: Makes it easier to understand the messages in the logs
descriptions.ImageBuilder: Allows students to create their own images and send them to each other
descriptions.KodeKnækkeren: Allows students to try their hand at cracking the code of an encrypted image
descriptions.Router: Allows students to choose the recipient of their messages, as well as control who receives messages through the server
descriptions.AutoRouter: Automatically sends messages to the correct recipient, without students needing to choose the recipient
descriptions.Encryption: Allows students to encrypt their messages, so they can only be read by the correct recipient
descriptions.Hacker: Allows students to modify messages through the server before they are sent to the recipient
descriptions.Beep: Controls whether the micro:bit should play a sound when it receives a message

flasher.title: Bit:Chat download tool
flasher.subtitle: This tool helps you download the Bit:Chat program to one or more micro:bits
flasher.serverDescription: This is your micro:bit that controls everything and must be connected to the computer again later.
flasher.clientDescription: This is one of your client micro:bits that you can use to send messages back and forth
flasher.programmingStateDescription: Keep the micro:bit connected to the computer until it has finished being programmed.
flasher.noDevicesSelectedDescription: Connect the micro:bit to the computer and select it in the list to be able to program it.
flasher.doneDescription:
All micro:bits have been programmed.
You can now proceed and use them to send messages back and forth.

duplicate.title: Download to micro:bit again?
duplicate.description: This micro:bit has already been programmed. Do you want to download the program to the micro:bit again? This will overwrite the existing program.
